{{Quote|He slipped through our fingers ''again''! All right&hellip; We're heading back to rejoin the fleet. We may have won this battle, but I wonder when we're going to get around to winning the war&hellip;|Anakin Skywalker, following Count Dooku's escape|<ref name="CWA" />}}
The '''Skirmish at the Austan Cluster''' was a battle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In an attempt to capture [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] a Republic fleet, led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], launched a surprise attack backing Dooku's Separatist fleet against the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the [[Austan Asteroid Cluster|Austan Cluster]].<ref name="CWA" />
